definitions.gloss: worth seeing, rewarding to look at
definitions.explanation: The quality of being worthwhile or rewarding to watch or look at — used for performances, exhibitions, scenery, or anything visual that repays the attention spent on it.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{見|み}がいがある。
{見|み}がいのある⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧だった。
examples.english: It was a match worth watching.

examples.japanese: ⟦{規模|きぼ}→規模：05095_kibo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{小|ちい}さい→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{質|しつ}→質：01425_shitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}く→高い：00500_takai⟧、{見|み}がいのある⟦{展覧会|てんらんかい}→展覧会：01470_tenrankai⟧だった。
examples.english: It was a small exhibition, but the quality of the works was high, and it was well worth seeing.

notes:
⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧(to see) + がい (from {甲斐|がい}, worth): something that rewards the effort of watching it.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {見|み}がいがある: to be worth seeing
- {見|み}がいのある⟦{展覧会|てんらんかい}→展覧会：01470_tenrankai⟧: an exhibition worth seeing

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{読|よ}みがい→読みがい：08074_yomigai⟧: worth reading
- やりがい: worth doing, rewarding
- {生|い}きがい: reason for living, purpose in life

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{見応|みごた}え→見応え：07274_migotae⟧: worth watching — near-synonym; ⟦{見応|みごた}え→見応え：07274_migotae⟧ leans toward visual substance or impact, while {見|み}がい leans toward the reward of having watched
